'''Gorg Singo'''<ref name="Concept">{{ArtStation|username=django42|url=artwork/G85bG3|name=[[Dylan Howie-Richardson]]|text=Obi-Wan Kenobi alien concept designs (1)|date=2022-11-28|quote=Work I did for the Obi-Wan Kenobi series on Disney+ designing makeup prosthetics. Featured are designs of aliens for Mos Eisley in Episode 1.}}</ref> was an [[alien]] individual who could be found on [[Tatooine]] at some point during [[9 BBY]]. Singo was seen departing from a [[Unidentified two-engined passenger transport|passenger transport]] parked at the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]], passing by the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who intended to board the same shuttle on a mission to save a young [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Equipment==
Gorg Singo wore layers of loose-fitting dark brown robes with what appears to be some sort of pouch or satchel.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GorgSingo-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Dylan Howie-Richardson]]
Gorg Singo first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series, which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}}</ref> The character was later identified by a concept art designed by concept artist [[Dylan Howie-Richardson]]. The concept design was then pushed forward to makeup prosthetic artist [[Shaun Smith]] and team.<ref name="Concept" />
